name: Angus mac Nisse
text: Angus mac Nisse is also known as Saint Macanus. He was a saint of early Ireland. He died around the year 514. He was so careful with the holy books that he would not put them in a bag. He carried them and moved on his hands and feet.

attributes.attribute: early Irish saint who refused to put the Scriptures in a bag

okr.objective: Record the saint Angus mac Nisse.
key_results: Tell how he carried the books.
